description:
Use this when the user wants subtitles in another language: "add Spanish subtitles", "captions in
Portuguese only". Lines keep their timing; a long clip takes a minute.
Not for: dubbing or voiceover (not done through assistants) or caption looks (style_clip). Undoable. Costs no
Horizon Units. Returns job_id for job_status.

language.description: Language name or code, e.g. Spanish or es; off removes it.

mode.description: bilingual (line plus translation under it) or replace (translation only).

name: translate_captions
title: Translate captions
